commits.message:
test(lint): require native array bounds findings

The off-by-one enum guard and missing signed lower bound currently
produce no native diagnostic in either source language.

feat(lint): diagnose unsafe array indices

Prove boundary inputs through pure native syntax paths in Go and
loGo/s. Unknown effects stop the proof, and valid enum guards stay
silent. Register a suppressible deny rule with operand spans and
extend the behavior fixtures and language contract.

See also: gosuda/gglint#6

test(cmd/go): gate simd eject fixture execution on [host-simd]

The unguarded simd-mode 'logos run .' SIGILLs on amd64 hosts below GOAMD64 v4: Z-width accumulator slot inits materialize before the AVX512() guard (latent on the base; root fix is #54). The arm64-aware host-simd condition keeps execution coverage on arm64 while the eject, vet, and oracle assertions still run everywhere.

Co-Authored-By: metaphorics <drivedon02+git@gmail.com>
